vsm2.20:1.1: Ayaṃ maggo, ayaṃ na maggoti evaṃ maggañca amaggañca ñatvā ṭhitaṃ ñāṇaṃ pana maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhi nāma.
vsm2.20:2.1: Taṃ sampādetukāmena kalāpasammasanasaṅkhātāya nayavipassanāya tāva yogo karaṇīyo.
vsm2.20:2.4: Āraddhavipassakassa hi obhāsādīsu sambhūtesu maggāmaggañāṇaṃ hoti, vipassanāya ca kalāpasammasanaṃ ādi.
vsm2.20:2.6: Apica yasmā tīraṇapariññāya vattamānāya maggāmaggañāṇaṃ uppajjati, tīraṇapariññā ca ñātapariññānantarā,
vsm2.20:2.7: tasmāpi taṃ maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhiṃ sampādetukāmena kalāpasammasane tāva yogo kātabbo.
vsm2.20:3.1: Tatrāyaṃ vinicchayo – tisso hi lokiyapariññā ñātapariññā tīraṇapariññā pahānapariññā ca.
vsm2.20:3.2: Yā sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘abhiññāpaññā ñātaṭṭhe ñāṇaṃ. Pariññāpaññā tīraṇaṭṭhe ñāṇaṃ. Pahānapaññā pariccāgaṭṭhe ñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.75).
vsm2.20:3.3: Tattha ‘‘ruppanalakkhaṇaṃ rūpaṃ, vedayitalakkhaṇā vedanā’’ti evaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paccattalakkhaṇasallakkhaṇavasena pavattā paññā ñātapariññā nāma.
vsm2.20:3.4: ‘‘Rūpaṃ aniccaṃ, vedanā aniccā’’tiādinā nayena tesaṃyeva dhammānaṃ sāmaññalakkhaṇaṃ āropetvā pavattā lakkhaṇārammaṇikavipassanā paññā tīraṇapariññā nāma.
vsm2.20:3.5: Tesuyeva pana dhammesu niccasaññādipajahanavasena pavattā lakkhaṇārammaṇikavipassanā paññā pahānapariññā nāma.
vsm2.20:4.1: Tattha saṅkhāraparicchedato paṭṭhāya yāva paccayapariggahā ñātapariññāya bhūmi.
vsm2.20:4.2: Etasmiṃ hi antare dhammānaṃ paccattalakkhaṇapaṭivedhasseva ādhipaccaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:4.3: Kalāpasammasanato pana paṭṭhāya yāva udayabbayānupassanā tīraṇapariññāya bhūmi.
vsm2.20:4.4: Etasmiṃ hi antare sāmaññalakkhaṇapaṭivedhasseva ādhipaccaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:4.5: Bhaṅgānupassanaṃ ādiṃ katvā upari pahānapariññāya bhūmi.
vsm2.20:4.6: Tato paṭṭhāya hi aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṃ pajahati, dukkhato anupassanto sukhasaññaṃ, anattato anupassanto attasaññaṃ,
vsm2.20:4.7: nibbindanto nandiṃ, virajjanto rāgaṃ, nirodhento samudayaṃ, paṭinissajjanto ādānaṃ pajahatīti (paṭi. ma. 1.52) evaṃ niccasaññādipahānasādhikānaṃ sattannaṃ anupassanānaṃ ādhipaccaṃ.
vsm2.20:5.1: Iti imāsu tīsu pariññāsu saṅkhāraparicchedassa ceva paccayapariggahassa ca sādhitattā iminā yoginā ñātapariññāva adhigatā hoti, itarā ca adhigantabbā.
vsm2.20:5.2: Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘yasmā tīraṇapariññāya vattamānāya maggāmaggañāṇaṃ uppajjati, tīraṇapariññā ca ñātapariññānantarā,
vsm2.20:5.3: tasmāpi taṃ maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhiṃ sampādetukāmena kalāpasammasane tāva yogo kātabbo’’ti.
vsm2.20:6.1: Tatrāyaṃ pāḷi – ‘‘Kathaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ?
vsm2.20:6.2: Yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā…pe… yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ aniccato vavatthapeti, ekaṃ sammasanaṃ. Dukkhato vavatthapeti, ekaṃ sammasanaṃ. Anattato vavatthapeti, ekaṃ sammasanaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.3: Yā kāci vedanā…pe… yaṃkiñci viññāṇaṃ…pe… anattato vavatthapeti, ekaṃ sammasanaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.4: Cakkhuṃ…pe… jarāmaraṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ aniccato vavatthapeti, ekaṃ sammasanaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.6: ‘‘Rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhena, dukkhaṃ bhayaṭṭhena, anattā asārakaṭṭhenāti saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.7: Vedanaṃ… viññāṇaṃ… cakkhuṃ…pe… jarāmaraṇaṃ…pe… sammasane ñāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.8: ‘‘Rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammanti saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.9: Vedanaṃ… viññāṇaṃ… cakkhuṃ… jarāmaraṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ…pe… nirodhadhammanti saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.10: ‘‘Jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ. Atītampi addhānaṃ, anāgatampi addhānaṃ jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ, asati jātiyā natthi jarāmaraṇanti saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.11: Bhavapaccayā jāti…pe… avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.12: Atītampi addhānaṃ, anāgatampi addhānaṃ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, asati avijjāya natthi saṅkhārāti saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇaṃ.
vsm2.20:6.14: Tena vuccati atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅkhipitvā vavatthāne paññā sammasane ñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.48).
vsm2.20:9.1: Ettha ca cakkhuṃ…pe… jarāmaraṇanti iminā peyyālena dvārārammaṇehi saddhiṃ dvārappavattā dhammā, pañcakkhandhā, cha dvārāni, cha ārammaṇāni, cha viññāṇāni, cha phassā, cha vedanā, cha saññā, cha cetanā, cha taṇhā, cha vitakkā, cha vicārā, cha dhātuyo, dasa kasiṇāni, dvattiṃsakoṭṭhāsā, dvādasāyatanāni, aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo, bāvīsati indriyāni, tisso dhātuyo, nava bhavā, cattāri jhānāni, catasso appamaññā, catasso samāpattiyo, dvādasa paṭiccasamuppādaṅgānīti ime dhammarāsayo saṃkhittāti veditabbā.
vsm2.20:10.1: Vuttaṃ hetaṃ abhiññeyyaniddese – ‘‘Sabbaṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññeyyaṃ. Kiñca, bhikkhave, sabbaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ?
vsm2.20:10.2: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, abhiññeyyaṃ. Rūpā… cakkhuviññāṇaṃ… cakkhusamphasso… yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi abhiññeyyaṃ.
vsm2.20:10.3: Sotaṃ…pe… yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi abhiññeyyaṃ.
vsm2.20:11.1: ‘‘Rūpaṃ…pe… viññāṇaṃ… cakkhu…pe… mano… rūpā…pe… dhammā… cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe… manoviññāṇaṃ… cakkhusamphasso…pe… manosamphasso….
vsm2.20:11.2: ‘‘Cakkhusamphassajā vedanā…pe… manosamphassajā vedanā… rūpasaññā…pe… dhammasaññā… rūpasañcetanā…pe… dhammasañcetanā… rūpataṇhā…pe… dhammataṇhā… rūpavitakko…pe… dhammavitakko… rūpavicāro…pe… dhammavicāro….
vsm2.20:11.3: ‘‘Pathavīdhātu…pe… viññāṇadhātu… pathavīkasiṇaṃ…pe… viññāṇakasiṇaṃ… kesā…pe… muttaṃ… matthaluṅgaṃ….
vsm2.20:11.4: ‘‘Cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ… cakkhudhātu…pe… manodhātu… manoviññāṇadhātu… cakkhundriyaṃ…pe… aññātāvindriyaṃ….
vsm2.20:11.5: ‘‘Kāmadhātu… rūpadhātu… arūpadhātu… kāmabhavo… rūpabhavo… arūpabhavo… saññābhavo… asaññābhavo… nevasaññānāsaññābhavo… ekavokārabhavo… catuvokārabhavo… pañcavokārabhavo….
vsm2.20:11.6: ‘‘Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ… mettācetovimutti…pe… upekkhācetovimutti… ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpatti…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpatti… avijjā abhiññeyyā…pe… jarāmaraṇaṃ abhiññeyya’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.3; saṃ. ni. 4.46).
vsm2.20:12.1: Taṃ tattha evaṃ vitthārena vuttattā idha sabbaṃ peyyālena saṃkhittaṃ.
vsm2.20:12.2: Evaṃ saṃkhitte panettha ye lokuttarā dhammā āgatā, te asammasanupagattā imasmiṃ adhikāre na gahetabbā.
vsm2.20:12.3: Yepi ca sammasanupagā, tesu ye yassa pākaṭā honti sukhena pariggahaṃ gacchanti, tesu tena sammasanaṃ ārabhitabbaṃ.
vsm2.20:13.1: Tatrāyaṃ khandhavasena ārabbhavidhānayojanā – yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ…pe… sabbaṃ rūpaṃ aniccato vavatthapeti, ekaṃ sammasanaṃ.
vsm2.20:13.3: Ettāvatā ayaṃ bhikkhu ‘‘yaṃkiñci rūpa’’nti evaṃ aniyamaniddiṭṭhaṃ sabbampi rūpaṃ atītattikena ceva catūhi ca ajjhattādidukehīti ekādasahi okāsehi paricchinditvā
vsm2.20:13.4: sabbaṃ rūpaṃ aniccato vavatthapeti, aniccanti sammasati.
vsm2.20:14.1: Tasmā esa yaṃ atītaṃ rūpaṃ, taṃ yasmā atīteyeva khīṇaṃ, nayimaṃ bhavaṃ sampattanti aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhena.
vsm2.20:14.2: Yaṃ anāgataṃ anantarabhave nibbattissati, tampi tattheva khīyissati, na tato paraṃ bhavaṃ gamissatīti aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhena.
vsm2.20:14.3: Yaṃ paccuppannaṃ rūpaṃ, tampi idheva khīyati, na ito gacchatīti aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhena.
vsm2.20:14.4: Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ, tampi ajjhattameva khīyati, na bahiddhābhāvaṃ gacchatīti aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhena.
vsm2.20:14.5: Yaṃ bahiddhā…pe… oḷārikaṃ…pe… sukhumaṃ…pe… hīnaṃ…pe… paṇītaṃ…pe… dūre…pe… santike, tampi tattheva khīyati, na dūrabhāvaṃ gacchatīti aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhenāti sammasati.
vsm2.20:14.6: Idaṃ sabbampi ‘‘aniccaṃ khayaṭṭhenā’’ti etassa vasena ekaṃ sammasanaṃ. Bhedato pana ekādasavidhaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:15.2: Bhayaṭṭhenāti sappaṭibhayatāya. Yañhi aniccaṃ, taṃ bhayāvahaṃ hoti sīhopamasutte (saṃ. ni. 3.78; a. ni. 4.33) devānaṃ viya.
vsm2.20:15.3: Iti idampi ‘‘dukkhaṃ bhayaṭṭhenā’’ti etassa vasena ekaṃ sammasanaṃ. Bhedato pana ekādasavidhaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:16.1: Yathā ca dukkhaṃ, evaṃ sabbampi taṃ anattā asārakaṭṭhena.
vsm2.20:16.2: Asārakaṭṭhenāti ‘‘attā nivāsī kārako vedako sayaṃvasī’’ti evaṃ parikappitassa attasārassa abhāvena.
vsm2.20:16.3: Yañhi aniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ, taṃ attanopi aniccataṃ vā udayabbayapīḷanaṃ vā vāretuṃ na sakkoti, kuto tassa kārakādibhāvo.
vsm2.20:16.4: Tenāha – ‘‘rūpañca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa. Nayidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyyā’’tiādi (saṃ. ni. 3.59).
vsm2.20:16.5: Iti idampi ‘‘anattā asārakaṭṭhenā’’ti etassa vasena ekaṃ sammasanaṃ. Bhedato pana ekādasavidhaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:17.1: Yaṃ pana aniccaṃ, taṃ yasmā niyamato saṅkhatādibhedaṃ hoti.
vsm2.20:17.2: Tenassa pariyāyadassanatthaṃ, nānākārehi vā manasikārappavattidassanatthaṃ ‘‘rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhamma’’nti puna pāḷi vuttā.
